env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^container ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/containeronly

go 1.27

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Circle struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type Square struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type Shape interface {
  Circle | Square
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"

  "example.com/containeronly/a"
)

type Holder struct {
  Vs []a.Shape `json:"vs"`
}

func main() {
  var h Holder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"vs":[{"s":7},{"r":3}]}`), &h)
  if err != nil {
    panic("container unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if len(h.Vs) != 2 {
    panic("container len")
  }
  sq, ok := h.Vs[0].(a.Square)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("container want Square got %T", h.Vs[0]))
  }
  if sq.S != 7 {
    panic("container want S=7")
  }
  c, ok := h.Vs[1].(a.Circle)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("container want Circle got %T", h.Vs[1]))
  }
  if c.R != 3 {
    panic("container want R=3")
  }
  fmt.Println("container ok")
}
